sudoku.name: Sudoku
sudoku.rules: Fill the grid: every row, column and 3×3 box has the numbers 1 to 9, none repeated.

trilha.name: Trilha
trilha.rules: Start at 1 and join the numbers in order with a single path, cell to cell, through every cell once. Walls can't be crossed.

cacapalavras.name: Caça-palavras
cacapalavras.rules: Find the theme's words in the grid: in a straight line, any direction, even backwards. Drag from the first letter to the last.
